summary: Maya (Northwind) ran discovery with Lars and Ingrid from Fjord Logistics. Bergen has a 3% mis-pick rate across about 40 pickers per shift, and they want it under 1% before the summer peak. Budget is about NOK 600k this year; CFO Henrik Dahl must approve anything above and should be involved early. They are also comparing a larger Autostore proposal. Target: a pilot starting in January.
